spec: C05-BUILD-SPEC.md 交付物 8 (stale LKG: sourceOids 变了,不得把另一份 sourceOids 的旧 LKG 冒充当前故障的兜底) + 交付物 5 'LKG 命中路径要实测一次'
description: Two-step orchestration under the SAME isolated root T (LKG_DIR must be shared across both runs): (1) prime — a successful `--dir <corpus-whole>` run writes a real LKG file keyed by sha(sourceOids_A={view:dir,dir:corpus-whole}, schemaVersion). (2) degrade — a run against a DIFFERENT --dir (the read-only ../index-emit-file-empty fixture; different dir string => different sourceOids_B => different LKG key) hits the dedicated file-empty diagnostic. W3-D (f9a8acf, Opus M3, guards/audits/OPUS-2026-09-24-c05-wave2-review.md) removed the old mtime-latest LKG bucket fallback that used to serve corpus-A's now-stale LKG file on a key miss (FINAL-SPEC §4: 'LKG 只在 key 命中才用'). New semantics: sourceOids_B's exact-key lookup misses (no file at that key) and degraded() goes straight to the title-only dead end -- no LKG-FALLBACK line at all, no stale content served. Empirically confirmed via isolated matrix run (builder report) after the semantics update: step 2's stdout is exactly 'PMM-DEGRADED file-empty:decisions.md\n' (no second line).
